name: ABB Traditional Mustard
about: A traditional hot mustard from Düsseldorf. It is a local favorite that people in the city often bring home as a gift.
tip: Buy the small stoneware jar. It is easy to pack and carry home.

name: Killepitsch Herbal Liqueur
where: Official retailer near Uerige, at Et Kabüffke
about: A herbal liqueur that is a well-known Düsseldorf specialty. It is a classic souvenir from the city.
tip: Check the volume and alcohol content on the label before you buy.
